description: This Java source file contains comprehensive integration tests for SQL injection prevention on report functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It verifies the security measures against SQL injection, normal operation with legitimate inputs, schema validation, cross-database compatibility, and concurrency safety.

classes.name: SqlInjectionReportingServiceIntegrationTest
classes.description: An integration test class for verifying SQL injection prevention mechanisms in report functionalities within the Apache Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including setting up REST client specifications and creating a test report.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up test artifacts, such as deleting the test report.

methods.name: createTestReportIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks for existing test report and creates one if absent, storing its ID for cleanup.

methods.name: deleteTestReport
methods.description: Deletes the created test report to maintain test isolation.

methods.name: uc1_testLegitimateReportExecution
methods.description: Verifies that legitimate report execution functions correctly without being affected by SQL injection protections.

methods.name: uc2_testParameterInjectionPrevention
methods.description: Tests that malicious parameters attempting SQL injection are safely handled and do not cause SQL errors.

methods.name: uc3_testValidReportTypes
methods.description: Checks that allowed report types ('report', 'parameter') are accepted.

methods.name: uc4_testInvalidReportTypes
methods.description: Ensures invalid report types are rejected appropriately, typically resulting in errors or 404 responses.

methods.name: uc5_testMySQLEscapingThroughAPI
methods.description: Tests escaping of MySQL-specific injection patterns to prevent SQL injection.

methods.name: uc6_testPostgreSQLEscapingThroughAPI
methods.description: Tests escaping of PostgreSQL-specific injection patterns to ensure safety.

methods.name: uc7_testConcurrentAccess
methods.description: Verifies thread safety of the system under concurrent report requests, ensuring no injection bypass occurs.

methods.name: uc8_testComplexParameterInjection
methods.description: Assesses handling of complex, nested, or maliciously crafted injection attempts.

methods.name: uc9_testLegitimateParameterTypes
methods.description: Validates that various legitimate parameter types are correctly processed without errors.

methods.name: uc10_testCrossDatabaseCompatibility
methods.description: Checks that the protections and behaviors are consistent across different database systems.

methods.name: toQueryString
methods.description: Utility to convert parameter maps to URL query string format.
